title.narrative: Supporting families in need with emergency food aid and building resilience in Yemen for the year 2024

description.narrative: Meeting the immediate food needs of approximately 500,514 beneficiaries from the most vulnerable groups in the governorates of (Hodeidah, Al Dhale’e, Marib, and Al Bayda), in addition to asset support activities for 45,850 direct beneficiaries, and more than 57,313 indirect beneficiaries to improve their access to food and become less dependent on humanitarian aid in the governorates of (Hadhramaut, Al Mahrah, and Socotra).
Providing and distributing 13,798 tons of food supplies to support resilience activities for 45,850 direct beneficiaries.

The project aims to contribute to reducing the number of families suffering from food insecurity by providing food assistance to the largest possible number of the most needy families, and to enhance the food security, livelihoods, and resilience of affected families and communities through the rehabilitation and creation of assets, and support for agriculture, to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals.
